title: Exploited Chrome XML use-after-free permits code execution inside the sandbox
summary: A crafted HTML page can exploit an XML use-after-free to execute code inside the browser sandbox. CISA added the vulnerability to its exploited-vulnerability catalog on November 10.

severity.rationale: Confirmed exploitation reaches browser code execution through untrusted pages. Agent browsing makes that content routinely reachable, warranting action within 24 hours.

affected.note: The vendor CVE description identifies Stable versions before this build. Other channels and Chromium-derived products require their own vendor fix mapping.

exposure: Browsers rendering untrusted HTML are exposed. This CVE establishes execution inside the sandbox, not a sandbox escape. Test browsers confined to trusted content have less exposure.

params.instructions: For Google Chrome Stable, read the executable version and update versions below 157.0.8103.50. For other channels or derived browsers, verify the vendor has incorporated the CVE-2026-125350 fix.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Install the current patched vendor browser and restart it. Chrome Stable builds from 157.0.8103.50 address this CVE; verify other channels against their vendor notices.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating and restarting can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed version and the component used by running processes meet the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.

exploitation.note: Listed in CISA KEV on November 10, 2026.
